insight: Built by the founders of Osmo, the kids' AR-learning system acquired for around $120M in 2019; Napkin has since passed 5M+ users.
name: Napkin AI
tagline: Turn your text into editable diagrams, infographics, and visuals.
description: A visual AI for business storytelling that converts written text — prose, outlines, notes — into editable diagrams, flowcharts, mind maps, and infographics in seconds. Generates multiple visual options from a passage, then lets you tweak icons, connectors, colors, and fonts and export to PNG, PDF, or SVG for decks, blogs, and docs.

modelSupport.notes: Proprietary text-to-visual pipeline over LLM parsing.

edge: Generates editable, on-brand diagrams and infographics inline from your text — not full slide decks (Gamma) or freeform images (diffusion tools).
cons: Best for diagrams, not freeform illustration

references.title: Napkin AI attracts over five million users
